articles.title: These students are bringing diversity to children's literature, one book at a time
articles.summary: Western students are writing and illustrating picture books through a multicultural lens, so more kids can find people like themselves in the stories and media they grow up with.

articles.title: Science students create, donate books tackling representation
articles.summary: A group of Western science students make picture books that bring marginalized stories to young readers, then donate copies to libraries across London.
